comments.author: @MrJodyh54
comments.text: Travelling here? They did not tell you-get  vaccinations prescribed by  your home country (typhoid, etc),   have accident/health insurance payable immediatley in Vietnam or immediate access to $5,000 usd. If you are in an accident or get ill and need medical attention at a hospital, they do no more than receive you until they receive payment. That means you lay on a bed in the hall and could be dying until payment or downpayment is made. This is a dusty, dirty and dangerous place to travel in. Don't be fooled by these videos where everything is great-it is not and travelling is horrible by bus.
